gaps: Exact islet count is not established: the automated count failed (tint thresholding mixes islet fill and outlines); about 20 is a hand count at 4x of band px 60,0,308,130 and the strip below it, and the Paerāndas canon says over a thousand islands.
Region letters and label clipping (PAERĀNDAS D, PĒSHUNOR H, LAMOR M, DRANIMOS O) were read by eye from the tiles; none was OCRed.
Whether the river is a single line under the L of LEPONNIA, where it continues beyond the west edge, its flow direction and any name are not established.
Dotted-road length is a floor (97 detected dots at 3.96 atlas px pitch); dots at junctions and under type were missed, and the edge-crossing y values (1451, 1454, 1529) are good to about 3 px only.
That the printed north-coast dotted road is the Road that Walks with the Sun is inferred from the wiki text and the trace direction; the print does not label it.

The War and Imperial era tiles (maps-site/tiles-war/5, tiles-imperial/5) were not examined in band W, so whether older sheets draw different roads, names or islets here is unknown (q04-c08 reports only 69-156 differing px on the three old-survey fixture tiles).
realms.geojson and minor-regions.geojson were outside this question's read list, so whether region polygons could feed reserve washes in band W was not examined.

Sea/land areas rest on a colour threshold (R-B<57 on non-ink pixels, ink assigned to the nearest class); the 27 percent sea, the 6.4 percent DEM-land/print-sea disagreement and the 60-67 percent sea-tone shares of the Sun Road and the North Coast Packet carry a few points of error.
Whether the wiki's 'line of hills' north of Epēshu corresponds to the DEM's 19-46 m rises in the Paerāndas strip (y1398-1442) is not established; the print shows sea there.
summary: Band W is a sparse stretch of the print: one ◉ and three ○ settlements, one dotted road net, one unlabelled river, a coast with about 20 islets and only letters of five region names, with no peaks, heights, homestead dots, washes, shields, trails, relief or graticule, and 5 of its 45 whole hexes are pure paper. The data files add little: maps_markers has 1 record (Epēshu), city-anchors 4, wiki-places none by position, and the Sun Road trace, 3 traced-roads chains and the North Coast Packet lane all sit in the sea 25-55 px off the printed road, so roads and the river must be re-traced and relief taken from the DEM (which covers the band).
